title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Traditional Brass Retractable Wall Hook | 15 lb Capacity Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade everyday storage with a wall mount retractable hook that pulls out for 2-1/2 inches of hanging space and pushes back in when not in use—crafted for traditional bathroom hardware pairings.

  • Retractable design: Extends to create 2-1/2" of hanging space, then retracts to stay out of the way
  • Strong everyday support: Holds up to 15 lb for robes, towels, or coats
  • Solid brass construction: Traditional styling designed to coordinate with classic bath accessories
  • Customizable tip: Remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own
  • Hardware included: Fits standard interior walls and includes mounting hardware

Specifications

  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Material: Brass
  • Style: Traditional
  • Hanging space (extended): 2-1/2"
  • Overall size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L
  • Projection: 1"
  • Product weight: 1 lb
  • Hardware: 6/32 toggles

Installation

  • Requires drilling a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall and 3 small holes around

Finish options

  • Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors such as antique pewter, lavender, sea foam green, autumn sparkle, and fire engine red

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
